mapper.select:
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM material m WHERE m.owner_type = #{ownerType} AND m.owner_key = #{ownerKey} AND m.lifecycle_state = #{lifecycleState} AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM material_scope_link library_scope WHERE library_scope.material_id = m.id AND library_scope.scope_type = 'LIBRARY' AND library_scope.scope_key IN ('personal', 'library', #{ownerKey}))
AND m.display_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query}, '%')

SELECT FROM material m LEFT JOIN material_version v ON v.id = m.latest_version_id AND v.material_id = m.id LEFT JOIN material_processing_revision r ON r.version_id = v.id AND r.revision_no = (SELECT MAX(latest_r.revision_no) FROM material_processing_revision latest_r WHERE latest_r.version_id = v.id) WHERE m.id = #{materialId} AND m.owner_type = #{ownerType} AND m.owner_key = #{ownerKey} AND m.lifecycle_state != 'DELETED'

SELECT v.id AS versionId, v.version_no AS versionNo, v.detected_mime AS detectedMime, v.byte_size AS byteSize, v.page_count AS pageCount, v.ingest_state AS ingestState, r.state AS processingState, r.stage AS processingStage, COALESCE(r.progress, 0) AS progress, v.created_at AS createdAt FROM material_version v JOIN material m ON m.id = v.material_id AND m.owner_key = #{ownerKey} LEFT JOIN material_processing_revision r ON r.version_id = v.id AND r.revision_no = (SELECT MAX(latest_r.revision_no) FROM material_processing_revision latest_r WHERE latest_r.version_id = v.id) WHERE v.material_id = #{materialId} AND v.owner_key = #{ownerKey} ORDER BY v.version_no DESC

SELECT link.id, link.material_id AS materialId, link.scope_type AS scopeType, link.scope_key AS scopeKey, link.created_by AS createdBy FROM material_scope_link link JOIN material m ON m.id = link.material_id WHERE link.material_id = #{materialId} AND m.owner_type = #{ownerType} AND m.owner_key = #{ownerKey} ORDER BY link.created_at, link.id

mapper.insert:
INSERT IGNORE INTO material_scope_link ( id, material_id, scope_type, scope_key, created_by ) SELECT #{linkId}, m.id, #{scopeType}, #{scopeKey}, #{ownerKey} FROM material m WHERE m.id = #{materialId} AND m.owner_type = #{ownerType} AND m.owner_key = #{ownerKey} AND m.lifecycle_state = 'ACTIVE'
AND (#{scopeKey} IN ('personal', 'library') OR #{scopeKey} = #{ownerKey})
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM diagram d WHERE d.id = #{scopeKey} AND d.user_id = #{ownerKey} AND d.deleted = 0)
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM chartbook c WHERE c.id = #{scopeKey} AND c.owner_key = #{ownerKey} AND c.status = 'ACTIVE')
AND 1 = 0
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM material_scope_link WHERE id = #{linkId} AND material_id = #{materialId}
